# CodeCanopy

CodeCanopy is a free, open-source Codex plugin for turning an engineering goal into the smallest useful ownership tree and ordering work through artifact dependencies.

- Runtime: Codex only in v0.2.
- Contract: one root lead owns integration and the final verdict; dependency-ready leaves execute; results are verified and integrated bottom-up.
- Routing: each node receives normalized complexity and size scores; weighted thresholds select worker, expert, lead, or reviewer automatically, with safety overrides for root, integration, security, and uncertainty.
- Benchmark: the checked-in deterministic policy fixture passes 10/10 routing cases and rejects 3/3 invalid score cases; this is policy evidence, not model quality or latency evidence. Source: https://github.com/adhit-r/codecanopy/blob/main/benchmarks/model_routing.py
- Boundary: CodeCanopy's root creates and verifies isolated worktrees where needed. The host enforces documented sandbox, approval, model-availability, and concurrency boundaries.
- Configuration can tune planning limits but cannot grant authority.

Primary page: https://adhit-r.github.io/codecanopy/
Repository and installation: https://github.com/adhit-r/codecanopy#install
Current v0.2 work: https://github.com/adhit-r/codecanopy/issues/1
Future research, not shipped support: Claude adapter https://github.com/adhit-r/codecanopy/issues/4; mixed-provider CLI https://github.com/adhit-r/codecanopy/issues/5.
